On Mon, May 17, 2021 at 9:35 PM Stephanie Sasser < [opaque block] [contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Nikki and Rahima,
Hope you're both doing well, and thanks for reaching out! I'd be happy to set up some time to discuss
how we might work together on these areas. Would this Thursday at 2:00 or 2:30 ET work for you?
Otherwise Monday 5/24 is pretty open.
If you haven't already, you might want to check out some of the posts we ve put out about the
company's COVID/vaccine-related work. This is certainly not exhaustive but might help give a sense of
where we're focused:
• Supporting Vaccination Efforts on Our Apps
• Supporting Equitable Access to COVID Vaccines
Keeping People Safe & Informed About Coronavirus - this is sort of a running list of
various initiatives from 2020
Best,
Stephanie
